title: Train
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There is an $N$-car train.

You are given an integer $i$. Find the value of $j$ such that the following statement is true: "the $i$-th car from the front of the train is the $j$-th car from the back."

## Constraints

- $1 \leq N \leq 100$
- $1 \leq i \leq N$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N i
```

## Output

Print the answer.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

有一列由 $N$ 节车厢组成的火车。

给定一个整数 $i$。请找出满足以下陈述的 $j$ 的值：“从火车前方数第 $i$ 节车厢，是从火车后方数第 $j$ 节车厢。”

## 约束条件

- $1 \leq N \leq 100$
- $1 \leq i \leq N$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N i
```

## 输出格式

输出答案。

samples.note: The second car from the front of a $4$-car train is the third car from the back.
